STANDARDS & SUSTAINABILITY

Quality & Environmental
Policy

Deep Blue Aquatic Systems designs, manufactures and commissions aquatic systems engineered to sustain valuable life, optimize water use, and protect precious aquatic resources.

1. Commitment to Life Support Excellence

Because our systems sustain millions of live aquatic animals and provide critical water for farms and public facilities, we maintain uncompromising quality standards across design engineering, material selection (food-grade GRP, UV-stabilized HDPE, stainless steel 316), hydraulic calculations, and automated fail-safes.

2. Environmental Stewardship & Water Conservation

Our core mission is the promotion of closed-loop recirculating systems (RAS) and precision water treatment that drastically reduce raw water consumption, eliminate wastewater discharge, and recycle valuable nutrients for agriculture and aquaponics.

3. Biosecurity & Chemical Reduction

We advocate physical filtration (drum filters, foam fractionation), biological nitrification, and clean non-chemical disinfection (UV, ozone) over harsh chemical dosing, ensuring biosecure conditions for fish, livestock, and humans alike.

4. Engineering Precision & Continuous Testing

All control panels, motor control centres (MCC), pump manifolds, and filtration skids undergo rigorous mechanical and electrical pressure and performance testing in our Strand facility before field delivery.

5. Industry Certification & Standards

We work in alignment with South African SANS standards, municipal water regulations, and international aquaculture engineering best practices.

Specialist aquatic engineering and water technology company based in Strand, Western Cape.
